name: Documentation
description: Documentation App — clone, browse and edit a docs git repository added to a space.

apps.title: Documentation
apps.description: Browse and edit a documentation repository.

parameters.label: Access token
parameters.description: Secrets Store key holding the git token, as <storeId>/<key>

actions.description: Find the pages that answer a question. Pass `query`: the words you expect on the page, in any order, case-insensitive ("worktree node_modules install"); a word also finds its plural and -ing/-ed forms, and "quoted text" must appear as written. Pages holding every word come first, ranked so that rare words and words in the title, a heading or the path count most; when no page holds them all, the closest pages are returned, each with the words it lacks. Use 2-4 distinctive words (names, commands, identifiers) rather than a sentence. Pass `pattern` instead for a regular expression (JavaScript syntax with the `u` flag, case-insensitive), e.g. `^## ` to list sections; escape only characters that need it (`\#` is refused), and a pattern that runs for over a second is stopped. Searches this app by default; `apps: "*"` searches every documentation app in one ranked list. Only the published version is searched; drafts never match. The answer is text: each page with its path, title and best matching lines (`L<line>`), then how to `read` from a line.

query.description: Words to find, in any order; "quoted text" as written.

pattern.description: A regular expression instead of query (JavaScript syntax, case-insensitive).

apps.description: Where to search: "*" for every documentation app, or a list of app addresses (<space>.<app-slug>). Default: this app.

limit.description: Pages to return, best first (default 6, at most 100).

actions.description: Read a doc by its relative path (must end with .md). Default reads the PUBLISHED version, the one readers see (the branch as pushed to its remote); a page never published has none and the read fails. Pass version "draft" for saved-but-unpublished working-tree edits. Optional offset/limit slice by 1-indexed line.

version.description: Which content to read: "published" (default) or "draft" (the unpublished draft, including what people are typing into it right now).

limit.description: Number of lines to return. Default: read to end.

actions.description: Replace an exact string in a doc. Fails if oldString is not unique unless replaceAll is true. Mirrors the behavior of the regular Edit tool.
Create or overwrite a doc. Creates parent directories as needed. Path must end with .md.
Commit and push a single file. Other staged changes are not pulled into the commit.

path.description: Relative path of the file to commit.

actions.description: Pull the latest changes from the remote (rebase).
